description: This PHP script handles saving a project template in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM. It creates a new 'AM_ProjectTemplates' bean, populates it from POST data, saves it, and redirects to a Gantt Chart view.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create new bean objects in the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: populateFromPost
methods.description: Populates a bean object with data from POST request.
